map.依据目标等效批次与单卡批次，计算梯度累积步数，适用于显存受限下的等效大批次训练配: From the target equivalent batch size and the per-card batch size, compute the number of gradient accumulation steps, for configuring equivalent large-batch training under limited video memory and for distributed strategy design.
map.累积步数 = ⌈目标批量 / (单卡批量 × 卡数)⌉: Accumulation steps = ceil(target batch / (per-card batch x number of cards))
map.显存不够放大 batch 时，用小批量连续跑若干步再把梯度相加、只做一次参数更新: When video memory is too small for a large batch, run several consecutive small batches and add the gradients together, updating the parameters only once; this is equivalent to large-batch training. Note that normalization layer statistics and BatchNorm are still computed per small batch, so it is not fully equivalent to a true large batch; the learning rate must be scaled up with the equivalent batch.
map.等效 batch=单卡 batch×累积步数×GPU 数；累积步数=目标 bat: Equivalent batch = per-card batch x accumulation steps x number of GPUs; accumulation steps = target batch / per-card batch.
map.显存不足时用小 batch 累积多次再更新，模拟大 batch 的统计效果。: When memory is short, accumulate several small batches before updating to mimic the statistics of a large batch.
map.累积期间不更新参数、只累加梯度，故优化步数变少、训练更慢但等效 batch 更大: During accumulation the parameters are not updated, only the gradients are added, so the number of optimization steps drops and training is slower but the equivalent batch is larger.
map.：目标 batch=128、单卡 batch=32、2 卡 → 累积步数=128: : Target batch = 128, per-card batch = 32, 2 cards gives accumulation steps = 128/(32 x 2) = 2. Gradients are accumulated over every 2 small steps before one update, giving an equivalent batch of 128.
map.等效 batch 相同则统计近似一致，但累积使更新频率降低、训练更慢；学习率应按: With the same equivalent batch the statistics are approximately the same, but accumulation lowers the update frequency and training is slower; the learning rate should be set for the equivalent batch, not the per-card batch.
map.累积步数设太大怎样？: What if the accumulation steps are set too large?
map.等效 batch 过大易泛化变差、显存虽省但训练极慢；且 BN 统计仍按小 ba: Too large an equivalent batch tends to generalize worse; although memory is saved, training is extremely slow, and BN statistics still follow the small batch and differ from a true large batch, so BN momentum must be raised or synchronized BN used.
